content_html_sanitized:
Posted March 28, 2001
(MarijuanaNews note: A week before the Supreme Court’s hearing on the Oakland CBC, the DEA finally stops playing bureaucratic games and throws a hardball. They had previously sent the Gettman petition over to HHS, giving the impression that they were passing it on without objection.
See
Dea Finally Confirms The Existence Of Sufficient Grounds To Remove Marijuana From Hard Drugs Schedule Of Controlled Substances

Of course, HHS could be counted on to do their duty to the Fatherland, and so they did. They were polite enough to let the DEA deliver the coup de grace. This is a very, very cynical piece of work.)

-end-
